stories.title: Buckley: Flintshire Council reverses Brunswick Road  pedestrianisation with new traffic order
stories.summary: Traffic will be allowed back onto Brunswick Road in Buckley from 21 September, under a new order made by Flintshire County Council. The council made the order on 8 September. stories.title: Reform MS says British Empire was “force for good” in Senedd clash with culture minister
stories.summary: The British Empire was declared a “force for good” by a Reform MS during questions to Wales’ culture minister. stories.title: Flintshire Council writes to Transport for Wales over ‘Tap and Go’ rail fare signage
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s chief executive has written to Transport for Wales asking for new signage at stations on the Wrexham to Bidston line, after Tap and Go ticket machines were found to charge full adult fares regardless of age or Railcard status.
